stories.headline: US–China experts propose military AI safeguards
stories.summary: Security experts propose red lines around nuclear systems, human control over consequential cyberattacks and an AI-incident hotline. Neither government has endorsed the recommendations, and doubts remain about crisis hotlines.

stories.headline: Huawei says Chinese AI-chip demand exceeds supply
stories.summary: Huawei says it cannot meet domestic demand for AI computing equipment and plans earlier 2027 releases for two Ascend processors. Its claim that Ascend's China share exceeds Nvidia's was not supported with market data.

stories.headline: Federal Reserve raises rates to 3.75%–4%
stories.summary: The Fed unanimously raised its overnight target by a quarter point, its first increase since 2023, citing persistent inflation. Chair Kevin Warsh attributed higher bond yields mainly to economic strength, investment and geopolitical risk.

stories.headline: Russia launches major overnight attack on Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials reported more than two dozen injuries and damage across eight regions after missiles and nearly 160 drones. Russia said it struck military-used vessels; the barrage followed US House approval of new sanctions.

stories.headline: UN mission alleges war crimes by US and Iran
stories.summary: UN investigators found reasonable grounds to believe two US strikes in Iran were war crimes and that Iran committed crimes against humanity during protest crackdowns. Both governments have disputed related allegations.
